listed_sector_signals.signal: Case-study plant manufacturing synthetic resins (polymers/petrochemicals) that achieved SEP energy-management certification
listed_sector_signals.quote:
In 2010, a relatively small-scale plant that manu-
factures synthetic resins near Houston, TX, became 
one of the first facilities to achieve SEP certification.

listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference to chemical process industries facilities among SEP-certified sites
listed_sector_signals.quote:
including six in the chemical process industries (CPI) that 
improved their energy performance by 6–17% over a three-
year period.

one_line: A DOE overview article explaining how manufacturing and processing facilities can implement the ISO 50001 energy-management standard and earn Superior Energy Performance (SEP) certification, illustrated with generic CPI/synthetic-resins case studies rather than an empirical study of a specific continuous-flow production process.
